notation.meaning: graph with node set \(V\) and edge set \(E\); every edge has a source and a target; the simple reading merges parallel edges and drops loops
degree of node \(i\) in the simple undirected reading
number of triangles through \(i\): edges among the neighbours of \(i\)
weight of the edge between \(i\) and \(j\); \(s_i=\sum_j w_{ij}\) is the strength

adjacency matrix of a directed graph; \(d_i^{\mathrm{tot}}=d_i^{\mathrm{in}}+d_i^{\mathrm{out}}\), \(d_i^{\leftrightarrow}=(A^2)_{ii}\) the number of reciprocated partners

formulas.name: Local clustering coefficient (Watts and Strogatz 1998)
formulas.where: Fraction of pairs of distinct neighbours of \(i\) that are adjacent. Defined for \(k_i\ge2\); the denominator is 0 below two neighbours.

formulas.name: Average clustering
formulas.where: Mean of \(C_i\); the node set \(V'\) is either the nodes with \(k_i\ge2\) (where \(C_i\) is defined) or all of \(V\) with \(C_i:=0\) below two neighbours. These give different values when low-degree nodes exist.

formulas.name: Weighted clustering (Barrat et al. 2004)
formulas.where: Triangles weighted by the average of the two weights at \(i\); defined for \(k_i\ge2\) and \(s_i>0\).

formulas.name: Weighted clustering (Onnela et al. 2005)
formulas.where: Geometric mean of the three scaled triangle weights, summed over ordered neighbour pairs; defined for \(k_i\ge2\).

formulas.name: Directed clustering (Fagiolo 2007)
formulas.where: Counts all directed triangle types through \(i\) relative to the possible ones; the denominator is 0 when \(i\) has fewer than two distinct partners.

variants.clustering: The node coefficient \(C_i\) (or its weighted forms) for every node.
variants.average_clustering: The mean of the node coefficients, over the nodes where it is defined or with 0 for nodes below two neighbours (the two conventions give different means).
variants.nxo_directed_clustering: Fagiolo's directed coefficient \(C_i^D\) in place of \(C_i\), from the directed adjacency matrix.
variants.cat_clustering_extended: Documented for graph-tool as an extended clustering coefficient; the definition is not recorded in the sources.
